subject: Spiked drinks...
author: SUFFUR
body:
Don't get me started on spiked drinks, its happen to me 3 times now, and the first one really messed me up( i was up for 56 hours and going through a break up), the others, i knew what was happening straight away, and yes when you know, you can deal with it, but as far as i'm concerned, don't waste that type of drug on me, i don't need drugs and booze to have a good time, even if i don't show it on the outside, i'm normally happy on the inside( the reason someone spiked me the second time, as they thought i needed cheering up, muppets). Not that i would not say no, to a bottle of Tequila, or a crate of Desperado beer, Mexican beer, shot of Tequila, made in France? Or a social smoke of the Natures Herb, from the countries that have made it a controlled substance. 😉

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when its going to run out?

Another saying that i did put in the original  Podcast blog, was "Man created God, to say, God created Man" And if people are offended by this, know that, i believe, in faith, belief and devotion, i don't believe in religion as it were, as it was created to control the unlearned masses, so they did not think, that the sky was going to crash down on thier heads, and that there was someone out there looking out for them. There probably is, i know i have a guardian angel, and i also have good friends who do the same, as well as there are people out there who do genuinely care about thier fellow human beings ( i have met a few, and try to live by example). Going to church or a place of worship is a place to network and feel safe with fellow believers, which is cool, but not when it now involves politics and weapons of mass distruction. Yes its the story of life, but we only have one (though i do believe in the Budist way, of re-encarnation)(yes still not using Word, lol), and if you don't use it the way you want to, what else would you do, pretend to live. And no, this is not a dig, just my frame of mind, i have played more hours on computer games than most people, it could be seen as a waste, but that was what i wanted to do, i did not hurt anyone, i was happy doing it and it has made me the person i am today, i did have a life crisis a while ago, but nothing was going my way, but since i was not making it go my own way, i should not lose it like i did. Don't get me wrong, having a bad day, means you enjoy the good ones so much more.

To those who believe in God, keep doing it, it works for you (and if covers the bets if he is out there), but until i meet Him, at Heavens Gate, or the other of Mans creations, at Hells Gate( i too like hedging my bets, lol and know that i am not perfect). I do live an honest life, care for the World, we only got one 'them' at the moment, and smile to, say hello and help, anyone i please, as long as no hardship is caused, its all good, right? Not that it can't  be helped if you stamp on someones toes once in a while😉.

Suffur the Philosopher (another word for Bullshitter, see History of the World Part 1, Dir. Mel Brooks)

Another thing has just come to me from the blog of the Podcast, that was lost😢, (may the Ghost in the Shell worship it as litrature to shame Shakespere), i was yawning a lot so i used this emo, 😲, but i had a thought that it did look like a person standing next to me, looking right, shocked at a urinal, while i pee'd, which is nice, as i know i'm clean lol.

Anyway, something written to provoke the mind, piss off some people, have a good read, but to fill the gap in my 💔, with the loss of another blog.
